// diagnostic

E1237

A build step tried to write outside the output root.

What

A build step tried to write outside the output root.

Why

A build may only install files under its own package output root; writing elsewhere would let a build mutate the machine or other packages (D-JPK-ADAPTER1).

Fix

Install into a path under the output root (no `..`, no absolute paths).
